name: clock
description: The time now, with alarms and timers: set one here, and it rings here when its time comes, with a sound and a notification if the browser allows, until it is dismissed or given five more minutes. Under the time is what is coming: the reminders set and whatever is on today from the calendar's types. A reminder is a record, so it also shows on the calendar and on its own page.

use.when: a person wants to know the time, be reminded at a time, or time something: in a corner, a header, or a pane.
use.not: a whole month, which is a calendar, or a date to choose, which is a datepicker.
use.with: a calendar, which shows the same reminders on their days.

label.description: Names the region, so landmark navigation can reach it.

detail.title: How much to show
detail.description: glance is the time and anything ringing, for a header or a corner. full adds the forms to set a timer or an alarm and what is coming up.

sound.title: Ring out loud
sound.description: Whether a ringing reminder makes a sound as well as showing.

now.description: The moment shown, as RFC 3339. Filled in by the server; the page keeps it ticking.

time.description: The time shown, as HH:MM. Filled in by the server.

date.description: The day shown in words. Filled in by the server.

ringing.description: Reminders whose time has come and that nobody has dismissed. Filled in by the server.

text.description: What it is about, when it is about something: Water, 3 of 8 glasses so far.

upcoming.description: What is coming, soonest first, in one list: reminders still to ring, and whatever is on today from every type with a day. Filled in by the server.

id.description: A reminder's id, which gives it Cancel. Nothing else has one.

day.description: The day in words when it is not today: Tomorrow, Monday, 2 Oct.

time.description: The time, as HH:MM, or All day.

keyboard.does: reaches the timer and alarm fields and buttons, each reminder's link, and Dismiss and five more minutes on one that is ringing
sets the timer or alarm, or dismisses

wcag.notes: A named region, so it is reachable by landmark navigation. A ringing reminder is announced at once: the list of ringing ones is an alert region, and each one names itself in words before any sound. Nothing dismisses itself; a reminder rings until a person dismisses it or asks for five more minutes (2.2.1). The sound can be turned off with the sound prop and is never the only signal. Every field has a visible label, the alarm time a visible hint, and none leans on a placeholder; the alarm field offers a whole keyboard, since 7pm and tomorrow are words. The time is a time element with a machine-readable moment, and the forms are plain forms that work without scripts; scripts only keep the time moving and bring a reminder that rings while the page is open.

machine.identify: data-now is the moment shown. Ringing reminders are inside .sw-clock__ringing, each with data-id. Coming up is the list labelled Coming up, soonest first, each item with data-kind (alarm, timer, event); reminders carry data-id and Cancel.
machine.operate: To set a timer, fill Timer, in minutes and activate Start timer; to set an alarm, fill Alarm time (7:30, 7pm, tomorrow 6am) and, if wanted, What for, and activate Set alarm. The page then says what was set and when it rings, with Undo. Each makes a reminder record, which is also at /t/reminder. Dismiss and five more minutes are the forms on a ringing reminder.
